newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Strauss says to buy out Elite partner.
newsitem.headline: Strauss says to buy out Elite partner.

text.p: Israel's Strauss Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it would buy out its partner's stake in Elite Industries, one of Israel's leading food manufacturers.
Michael Strauss, head of the company which owns Strauss Dairies, said in a statement he would exercise an option to buy out Elite's biggest shareholder, the Federman group.
The statement said Strauss would pay 226.86 million shekels ($66 million) for the Federman group's 13 percent equity holding and 26.28 percent voting rights of Elite.
Strauss said the deal would give it 30.69 percent of the equity and 46.24 percent of voting rights in Elite.
The purchase resolved an agreement between the partners, who have been feuding over running Elite, whereby one would buy out the other's shares.
Elite has undergone far-reaching changes since the Strauss family came on the scene. Much of the company's loss-making European businesses, acquired in 1992, have been closed or sold off.
